root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive PowerShell commands via GitHub Actions' auto-generated temp .ps1 wrapper script on a Windows runner. The runner's PowerShell execution policy blocks loading any .ps1 file (PSSecurityException / UnauthorizedAccess), unrelated to the benign Expand-Archive content. PR #39899 only updates the oneDNN GPU thirdparty submodule pointer (src/plugins/intel_gpu/thirdparty/onednn_gpu), which cannot affect the Windows runner's PowerShell execution policy. This is the 4th occurrence of the identical signature within ~18.5 hours, confirming a recurring runner-pool provisioning defect rather than an isolated incident.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a Windows-runner image/environment issue (PowerShell execution policy) triggered non-deterministically depending on the specific runner instance assigned to the job; it does not reproduce locally or depend on the PR diff.
recommended_actions: Ensure the Windows runner image / bootstrap sets PowerShell execution policy to RemoteSigned or Bypass for the actions-runner service account so GitHub Actions' auto-generated .ps1 wrapper scripts can be loaded.
Alternatively, have the 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step invoke PowerShell explicitly with `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` instead of relying on the default shell wrapper.

Escalate urgently to the Windows GPU runner pool/image owners: this is now the 4th occurrence in under 19 hours, indicating a bad image rollout or a subset of misconfigured runner instances still in rotation that needs to be drained.
prevention_strategies: Bake execution-policy configuration into the Windows runner image provisioning (Packer/Ansible/etc.) and add a post-provisioning smoke test that runs a trivial Expand-Archive PowerShell step to catch regressions before the image is promoted to production use. Consider quarantining/draining runner instances that fail this check.
historical_context: Identical signature previously observed on 2026-11-16 (run 43897852421, PR #39833) and twice on 2026-11-17 (run 44051380184, PR #39423; run 44054389090, PR #39839), all on the 'GPU unit tests' job's 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step. This is the 4th occurrence recorded in pattern c351b86e95419730, and the 3 most recent occurrences (10:32, 10:59, and this run at 11:58 UTC on 2026-11-17) all fall within the last 12 hours, crossing the recurring-escalation threshold again.
